fiction_notice: Original fiction. Not a real event, person, company or recording.

hooks.text: The room has no camera. The footage exists.
hooks.note: An absence and a contradiction in eight words. No setup needed.

hooks.text: He is watching the monitors. Something is filming him doing it.
hooks.note: More atmospheric, but tells the viewer the answer a beat too early.

hooks.text: The archive has a camera number that does not exist.
hooks.note: Good procedural hook, but abstract at second zero.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 pairs an absence with a contradiction in ten words and gives the viewer nothing to resolve except by staying. Hook 2 names the observer, which is the twist, and would spend the ending in the first two seconds.
final_twist: The recursion is not a display error. Each layer is a real vantage point, and at the deepest one the guard is already gone and something has already left the room.
music_mood: Single sustained low string tone, slowly detuning. No percussion. A pitch-descending drone enters at 0:34 and falls continuously through the recursive zoom, stopping dead at the final frame.
sound_bed: Fluorescent hum, chair creak, hard drive seeks, and one complete silence at the last cut.
